verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the platform collects its own fees, which are automatically wired to its bank account every month. The wallet infrastructure can split and transfer funds, which implies a per-transaction platform fee. Nothing documents how the fee or markup is configured, and nothing covers per-seller pricing or reporting. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-transaction application fee/markup mechanics, per-seller pricing configuration, revenue reporting separated from processing costs, independent corroboration.
